name: The 561 Group's medical knowledge and technology, and its upstreams, are aggressively standardized to raise one vertical slice of products
asks: "I need platformization, standardization, architecturalization, semantic deduplication, syntactic deduplication, and other such izations and ications done to the 561 Group's medical knowledge and technology, and upstream knowledges and technologies, even if it is breaks stuff, especially if it breaks stuff, becuase this is all early alpha code being maintained by one person, so we need aggressive standardization of this content and code. Your goal is to specifically increase the profitability, capacity, efficiency, capability, and/or strength of one vertical slice of product(s). Use your own highest level Fable reasoning to address how to realize the knowledge and technology we have using - and massively improving in the same way - our upstream technologies. Use up to two sonnet subagents as your staff." (2026-09-12). Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: personal-health pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group's medical knowledge and technology, and the knowledge and technology upstream of them, are standardized so that one vertical slice of medical products gains in profitability, capacity, efficiency, capability or strength.

requirements.says: The Group's medical knowledge and medical technology shall be platformized, standardized, architecturalized, and deduplicated both semantically and syntactically.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: "platformization, standardization, architecturalization, semantic deduplication, syntactic deduplication, and other such izations and ications done to the 561 Group's medical knowledge and technology".

requirements.says: The knowledge and technology upstream of the Group's medical knowledge and technology shall receive the same platformization, standardization, architecturalization and deduplication.
The standardization shall be carried out even where it breaks existing content or code.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: "even if it is breaks stuff, especially if it breaks stuff, becuase this is all early alpha code being maintained by one person, so we need aggressive standardization of this content and code."

requirements.says: The standardization shall preserve every capability of the content and code it standardizes.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: platformization is "not" removal of things with no consumers; see capabilities-are-platformized-not-pruned.

requirements.says: The standardized medical knowledge and technology shall increase the profitability, capacity, efficiency, capability or strength of one vertical slice of the Group's products.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: "specifically increase the profitability, capacity, efficiency, capability, and/or strength of one vertical slice of product(s)."

requirements.says: The realization of the Group's medical knowledge and technology shall use the Group's upstream technologies and shall improve those upstream technologies in the same way.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: "how to realize the knowledge and technology we have using - and massively improving in the same way - our upstream technologies."
